hotelGrowErrorBody: Nothing was changed. Check your connection and try again.
hotelGrowSoftInsight: {count, plural, =0{No open weekend dates in the next {days, number} days} one{# open weekend date in the next {days, number} days} other{# open weekend dates in the next {days, number} days}}
hotelGrowPreviewWaiting: Enter a valid voucher price to see the card as couples will see it.
hotelGrowEffectNote: Pause and End take effect for couples at once.
hotelGrowToastPaused: {title} is paused. Couples see the standing voucher price.
hotelGrowEndBody: Couples go back to the standing voucher price at once. Requests already sent keep their price. This cannot be undone.
hotelGrowOverError: The voucher price cannot be above the standard price, {max}.
hotelGrowEmptyValueError: Enter the voucher price in dinars, up to three decimals.
hotelGrowBestOnly: Only the best voucher price applies to a request. Prices do not stack.
hotelGrowNextReasonTitles: Add the title in both languages to continue.
hotelGrowNextReasonValue: Correct the voucher price to continue.
hotelGrowOfflineEdit: Offline. You can keep editing; publishing needs a connection.
hotelGrowEditorErrorBody: Nothing was saved. Check your connection and try again.
hotelGrowNoDatesError: Choose at least one event date.
hotelGrowDatesChosen: {count, plural, =0{No dates chosen} one{# date chosen} other{# dates chosen}}
hotelGrowOverlap: {title} at {value} already covers {dates}. The better voucher price applies.
hotelGrowEndBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
hotelGrowReasonEnd: Set a valid end date first.
hotelGrowPublishFailed: The window was not published. Nothing changed; try again.
hotelGrowAnFunnelDesc: Views, clicks, vouchers purchased, requests, confirmed bookings and redeemed vouchers in the period.
hotelGrowAnTopDesc: Confirmed bookings per package in the period.
hotelGrowAnDefViews: Each person counts once per {minutes, number} minutes, however many times they open your listing.
hotelGrowAnDefClicks: Taps on Message, Call, Directions or Share after viewing your listing.
hotelGrowAnDefConversion: Confirmed bookings divided by views in the same period, credited to the last view within {days, number} days.
hotelGrowAnInsufBody: Trends need at least {days, number} days of views. The totals so far are below.
hotelGrowAnRoleAnalytics: Your role sees listing performance only.
hotelGrowRwModerated: Ghazal moderates reviews. Reply once or report abuse. To hide or delete a review, ask support.
hotelGrowRwAskSupport: Ask support to hide or delete
hotelGrowRwReplyHelp: Public, signed with the venue name, and sent once.
hotelGrowRwReportBody: Choose the reason. Ghazal reviews it and the review stays visible until then.
hotelGrowStandingExplain: Every package with a voucher price shows it beside the standard price all the time. A window lowers it for chosen event dates.
hotelGrowStandingNote: Standing prices change in the package editor, not here.
hotelGrowNoEffect: This is not below the standing voucher price of {standing}, so it will not change what couples pay.
hotelGrowBelowFee: The saving would not be more than the {fee} voucher fee, so couples are not offered a voucher at this price.
hotelGrowFeeNote: Couples also pay Ghazal a {fee} voucher fee. It is not part of your price and you do not collect it.
hotelGrowOpenWeekendsBody: Open Thursday to Saturday dates in the next {days, number} days
hotelGrowWeekdaysBody: Open Sunday to Wednesday dates in the next {days, number} days
hotelGrowEndRequired: Choose an end date, or turn on Until I end it.
hotelGrowAnDefVouchers: Vouchers bought for your venue in the period, counted at payment, not at use.
